title: Sheep wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='74' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#4a3a2a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='74' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#4a3a2a'/>
  <!-- body: fluffy wool -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='22' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='56' r='11' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='56' r='11' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='72' r='10' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='72' r='10' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='10' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- wool shading -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='16' fill='#e8e0d0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#3a3a44'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='36' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#3a3a44' transform='rotate(-20 36 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='36' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#3a3a44' transform='rotate(20 64 36)'/>
  <!-- face fluff -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='9' fill='#4a4a55'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='2.6' fill='#fff8e8'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='38' r='2.6' fill='#fff8e8'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#2a2a33'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#2a2a33'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#c86b7a'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,10 40,30 60,30' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <polygon points='50,10 46,20 54,20' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <polygon points='50,20 44,30 56,30' fill='#3fc1ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='3.5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- hat stripe -->
  <rect x='44' y='27' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
</svg>
